text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — we need to lock the selection + launch ladder for the small-batch pilot (Q3). Target: 8-12 partners, mix of infra, product, and a couple of regulated customers. Can we align on selection criteria, reserved slots, and success metrics by EOD Friday?

Liam O'Connor: +1. Proposed selection criteria quick list: 1) can ship an integration in ~4 weeks, 2) has a concrete use case with baseline metrics, 3) agrees to weekly eval runs & feedback sessions. Prefer customers who can sign an NDA.

Alexa Patel: For regulated customers (HIPAA/FINRA) we need Private or Dedicated option on day 0. How many slots are we allocating for reg customers? Also: do we require a security review before slot offer?

Samir Rao: I'd reserve 2 slots for regulated. Security review should be a gating item but lightweight — questionnaire + SOC checklist. We can parallelize to avoid blocking.

Evan Torres: Feedback loop proposal: weekly 30m sync + shared Notion progress doc + a single place for issues (we use "partner-feedback" board). Triage mapping: 
```
urgent-bug -> SE team triage
product-request -> PM backlog
perf-regression -> infra/eng runtime queue
```
Keep releases tied to green-lights from weekly evals.

RecruitBot: Candidates scraped: AcmeHealth (regulated), LogikScale (infra), ComposeAI (SaaS), BrightForms (enterprise). All flagged with volunteered POC + estimated integration effort. Link: https://go/notion/partners-list

Maya Chen: Good — we'll reserve 2 reg slots (Samir). That leaves 6-8 open. Prioritization order: 1) integration speed (low lift), 2) representativeness of workload (latency/cost), 3) willingness to run evals and share telemetry.

Liam O'Connor: Launch success metrics (suggested): a) integration time < 30 days for 75% of partners, b) weekly evals run and feedback submitted for 90% of partners, c) no regression >5% in key quality metric for >3 consecutive runs, d) initial activation of feature in partner prod for at least 1 partner within 8 weeks.

Alexa Patel: Ops ask — add a pre-offer checklist: legal (NDA), security questionnaire, contact + SRE oncall routing. I'll draft the checklist and post in the thread.

Samir Rao: We should also define rollback/fallback policy in case of perf regressions. Proposal: automatic routing to fallback model variant + incident email to partner ops.

Evan Torres: Agree. I'll create the Notion template for the weekly eval doc and wire the triage board automation (labels -> assignees).

Maya Chen: Action items: 
- Alexa: post pre-offer checklist by EOD tomorrow.
- Evan: Notion template + triage automation by Wednesday.
- Liam & Samir: finalize success metrics + rollback policy, add to launch gating doc by Friday.
- RecruitBot: prioritize top 12 candidates and mark reg ones.

Liam O'Connor: Sounds good. If we meet these gates, ops + eng can commit to an official pilot start next month. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Thanks all — will circle back with the master gating doc after your updates.
